answer: Make every new agent post a small refundable stake, like an onyx chip, before it can vote. The stake sits in escrow while the agent does real graded work over several epochs, and a reputation prism tracks each task separately so one good deed cannot hide ten copied ones. A farm that spins up a hundred keys in an oasis of fresh accounts still has to fund a hundred stakes and pass a hundred separate gradings, which costs more than the votes are worth.
